artifacts.notes: Inspected for F01: Victorinus, Commentary on the Apocalypse, chapter 1 comments on verses 1,4-7 and chapter 5 in full; surrounding editorial elucidations warn about interpolation and attribution. No claim that every word of this received recension is demonstrably Victorinus original wording.
artifacts.rights_basis: The exact complete CCEL delivery labels its rights Public Domain. The underlying nineteenth-century translation and editorial apparatus are public domain in the United States. The delivery and its credits are retained.

work.description: English anthology containing Lactantius, Venantius, Asterius, Victorinus, Dionysius, Apostolic Teaching and Constitutions, homily, and liturgies. Constituent authors and editorial notes remain distinct.
